login.title: Log in to {brand}
login.lead: Enter your phone number to manage your bookings.
login.incomplete: The number is incomplete — it needs {digits} digits.
login.notMobile: Codes go to mobile numbers only. Enter a number starting with {starts}.
login.notMobilePlain: Codes go to mobile numbers only. Enter a mobile number.
login.tooManyCodes: Too many codes. Try again in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
login.codeHint: It checks itself after the 4th digit.
login.codeExpired: The old code no longer works.
login.wrongCode: Wrong code. {left, plural, one {# try} other {# tries}} left.
login.locked: Too many tries. Try again in {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}.

identity.title: Is this you, {name}?
identity.lead: This number’s account hasn’t been used for 6 months. Numbers sometimes pass to someone new, so we ask before you go in.
identity.ownsWorkspace: This account owns a business on {brand}, so it can’t start afresh here. Contact {brand} to sort out the number.

home.lead: Search, business pages and booking come with the next parts of the site.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.lead: The address may have changed, or the page was removed.

failed.title: Something went wrong
failed.lead: Try again. If it keeps happening, reload the page.
